decisions.rationale: The 2025 NOA total income is $122,407 and the pay stub annualizes to about $124,500, a material shortfall of about 13% versus the stated $142,500.
Chequing balance of $52,558 with 3 months of history and only payroll deposits covers the $27,600 down payment and closing costs.
The 2026-08-20 letter on letterhead, signed by HR, confirms permanent full-time employment since 2016, probation completed, with salary consistent with the application.
Ratios of 37.7% GDS and 40.3% TDS pass on the stated income but fail (about 43% and 46%) on the documented income, so they depend on the unresolved income shortfall.
